pages.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This exact image is a technical RPG Maker pixel-art TILE ATLAS page, NOT a scene. It contains six 256-pixel-wide strips placed side by side on a 1536x1024 canvas, all existing items stay at their EXACT original coordinates. Enhance only fine existing material grain inside floors, walls, rock, wood, metal, leaves and cloth, retaining the original palette, pixel-art forms, tiny markings and lighting. Keep EVERY shape, outline, object count, orientation, blank area, tile boundary and relative position exactly as supplied. Do not rearrange, enlarge, remove, duplicate, reinterpret or merge any object. No new objects, details that change identity, text, letters, symbols, shadows or decorative frame. Existing text and symbols must remain unchanged. Transparent empty areas must stay truly transparent, including large empty strips. Output aspect ratio 3:2 and target canvas 1536 x 1024. No crop, zoom, pan, margins or perspective changes. The result is a conservative fine-texture proposal for a technical atlas; prioritize exact preservation over adding detail.
